comment.text: Placeholder of an option input in the options list of a Single or Multi select field in the metadata template editor.

usage.context:
<TextInput
 type={InputType.text}
 value={option.value}
 hasError={duplicates[index]}
 onChange={(e) => onChange(index, e.target.value)}
 placeholder={t("Metadata:OptionValue")}
 maxLength={METADATA_NAME_MAX_LENGTH}
 scale
 />
 <IconButton
 iconName={CatalogTrashReactSvgUrl}
